{{Top}}
[[File:SpaceMine-RogueLeader.jpg|thumb|An example of a space mine near the Imperial prison facility at the Maw.]]
'''Space mines''' were weapons deployed in realspace to inflict damage upon enemy targets. Variants of this umbrella term include '''standard mines''', '''proximity mines''', '''sleeper mines''', '''seeker mines''', and '''ion mines'''. Usually around one meter in diameter, these devices activated when [[Starship/Legends|spacecraft]] (usually [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]]) came within a certain predefined range.

==Description==
[[Realspace/Legends|Space]] [[Mine/Legends|mines]] ranged from crude uses of [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroids]] to advanced units such as [[Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc./Legends|Merr-Sonn's]] [[Mark III Merr-Sonn Defender Ion Mine]]. Automated space mines were a real hazard to [[Starship/Legends|starships]] since they were hard to detect and could home in on a vessel. [[Proximity mine/Legends|Proximity mines]] were the most common type of space mine, as well as one of the simplest.<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>

==History==
Space mines were used in [[Space warfare/Legends|space warfare]] for thousands of [[Standard year/Legends|years]]. Used to destroy enemy starships and to block travel routes, space mines were most effective when deployed in areas with natural hazards such as [[Pulsar/Legends|pulsars]], [[Gas/Legends|gas]] [[Cloud/Legends|clouds]], and [[Ion storm/Legends|ion storms]]. Space mines were also deployed during siege warfare, blocking access to and front the surface of a targeted [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. Planetary inhabitants would be cut off from outside [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]], [[Fuel/Legends|fuel]], and resources, leading to a demoralized population.<ref name="EGWT" />

A large number of mines were and used in the [[Palpatine Mine Network]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="GPBTG">[[Galactic Phrase Book & Travel Guide (real-life book)|''Galactic Phrase Book & Travel Guide'']]</ref>

==Categories==
Many different types of mines have been employed throughout the history of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. Ever since the beginning of space travel, proximity mines, sleeper mines, seeker mines, and ion mines have been utilized in space combat.

*'''Standard mines''' were frequently deployed in large amounts, creating a large minefield and rendering entire areas of space impenetrable. Requiring actual contact for ignition, these weapons would release a highly explosive chemical charge that indiscriminately damaged or destroyed anything nearby. These mines were effective against vehicles of all types.

*'''Proximity mines''' were similar to standard mines, as they used explosions to damage enemy spacecraft. Whenever an enemy craft would enter a predetermined range, it would trigger a detonation sequence within the mine. The resulting blast would spray a cloud of shrapnel in a violent blast cloud, ranging from ten to one-hundred meters in diameter. Proximity mines were ideal for use against starfighters.

*'''Sleeper mines''' were very similar to standard mines, yet possessed stealth technology that rendered them difficult to detect on [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]].

*Once a target entered the radius of a '''seeker mine''', the weapon would home in on the vehicle at a moderate speed and collide, causing an explosion. Though less powerful than a standard mine, seekers were very hard to detect. These mines were used to devastating effect against starfighters and [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ships]] alike.

*'''Ion mines''' were used to disable enemy craft flying nearby. Working in the same manner as proximity mines, ion mines would ignite a large ion cloud, disabling all electronic equipment caught in the blast area.

*The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] also used special '''antimatter mines''' on rare occasions. These were dormant, tiny capsules of antimatter without propulsion, more or less undetectable and small enough to slip through certain [[Particle shield/Legends|particle shields]]. As they were extremely destructive, but also completely uncontrollable once released, they were not typically used in frequently traveled space.
